title.native: 真下社長に押し負けたい

136001.description: Anna, a female swordswoman, is asked to search for a girl in the "Lost Forest". There, she encounters a cute fairy, but after being caught, Anna realizes that it was all a trap. The missing women were all caused by these fairies. There is no escape now.

136002.description:
Ke suddenly finds herself transported back in time and becomes the maid of the famous Yuan Yuan. But when Yuan Yuan elopes with her lover, Ke is forced to pretend to be the beautiful courtesan. Follow Ke as she seeks her true love to return to her own time while pretending to be Yuan Yuan!

(Source: INKR)

136003.description: Luna and I are kissing every day. But this is not love. We're just friends. There is no way that such a sweet relationship can last forever... When the end of the relationship is announced unilaterally, and we don't feel the same anymore. What will happen to us?

136004.description: Saruta Torasuke, an idiot who loves to fight, senses the hidden strength of student council president Fujishiro Senju, and challenges him to a match. In the midst of the tussle, something changes in Fujishiro...?

title.native: 虎憑き会長、手合わせ願います！！

136008.description: One day Hyun gets chosen to test out a parenting game called Childminder. He thought the game would be easy because all he had to do was be a good father to a very cute child named Mir. Childminder is a tale of the hardships of parenting, even in a game.

136009.description:
Humanity is suffering from the worst drought in history, but it isn’t because there is no water. No, there is plenty of water. But we are no longer in charge. When the tide comes in, the fish come in. When the tide goes back out, the fish go back out, taking us with them inside. When our territory clashes with theirs, which species will prevail?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

136010.description:
Sensei finds himself attracted to an effeminate boy student who wears a dress.

(Source: DLSite)

136011.description: A three-issue miniseries that featured the "TMNT Supermutants" Turtle toys that were on sale at the time. The first volume of the anime miniseries followed this storyline.
synonyms: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles - Super Turtles

title.native: スーパー・タートルズ

136012.description:
Adelaide Sergio never knew luxury until she was reborn as a wealthy count’s daughter. She was set to inherit the family estate, but her scheming sister’s sudden engagement has thrown everything off. With just two weeks to find a husband, Adele turns to the temple in search of a holy knight, only to find that their commander is the perfect man! He’s handsome, respectable… and completely uninterested. Can Adele win over the cold commander in time, or will the silver spoon be yanked from her mouth?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Say Ah, the Golden Spoon Is Entering
Ah Yes, the Golden Spoon Has Arrived!
Oh Go Ahead, the Golden Spoon Is Entering
อ้าปากสิคะ เดี๋ยวฉันป้อนด้วยช้อนทอง
人生勝ち組令嬢が通ります

136013.description: A story of a young man changing a girls life
synonyms: My Parents Sold me into a Happy Family

title.native: 親に売られた私の幸せな家族
title.romaji: Oya ni Urareta Watashi no Shiawasena Kazoku

136014.description:
After transferring, Uruka Sengoku is having a hard time adjusting to the fancy private school. The only person she can talk to is her seatmate, Renka Himemiya, who is a huge fan of shoujo manga which filled her head with unrealistic expectations about love. Despite that, Sengoku finds herself feeling attracted to Himemiya. The school life of Himemiya-san, who is "in love with love," and Sengoku-san, who is "in love with the girl who is in love with love," will be filled with all the excitement of a shoujo manga! This is a girls-love comedy story that Himemiya-san would love.

(Source: Pocket Magazine, translated)

title.native: こいにこいするこに恋す
title.romaji: Koi ni Koi suru ko ni Koi su

136015.description:
Troy Qi was a young MMA world champion, crowned the strongest man in the world after a career-defining match. But his reign abruptly ends after he saves the life of troubled high school student Tori He, as she accidentally falls from a rooftop balcony. When Troy awakens, he finds that he died... and his soul has transferred into Tori’s body! Now the world’s strongest fighter must face his greatest battle yet: being a female fighter in high school.

(Source: Tapas)

136017.description: Alpha Gangseo fell in love with Detective Choi , an Omega at first sight! "What should I do with this troublemaking Alpha, who's chasing me to death with the desire to have sex with me?"

136018.description: A cold concrete floor.... Walls on all sides.... And a mahjong table... A man who lost his memory wakes up in a dungeon... An unprecedented mahjong mystery!

136020.description:
Suddenly making me the Empress? Suddenly live a life of luxury? Suddenly give me a harem of beautiful men? I knew there had to be a catch! The poor farmer girl's turnaround battle - a struggle to the death!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: There Are Always Monsters Who Want to Harm Me
Zǒng Yǒu Yāoguài Xiǎng Hài Zhèn

title.romaji: Zong You Yaoguai Xiang Hai Zhen

1. Ijippari ga Yuragu Toki (いじっぱりが揺らぐとき); Comic Shingeki 2017-03
2. Daisuki! Mitsune-sensei (大好きっ！みつね先生); Comic Shingeki 2016-10
3. Kateinai Soprano (家庭内ソープランド); Comic Shingeki 2016-07
4. Mama♥Lesson (ママ♥Lesson); Comic Shingeki 2015-12

6. Shikin Kyori Renai (至近距離レンアイ); Comic Shingeki 2015-07
7. Kanako-san no Oshigoto Jijou (加奈子さんのお仕事事情); Comic Shingeki 2015-04

136022.description:
“If you cry, I will no longer hesitate." Aki is exhausted by her husband's increasingly controlling behaviour. After returning to work, she happens upon her ex-boyfriend, Shuji, whom she was once hopelessly in love with. Everytime Aki and Shuji meet, she is troubled by his enduring love and understanding towards her. If she hadn't kissed him again, nothing would have come crumbling down, but...

(Source: MangaGo)
synonyms: Kiss Shitara Kowareru no wa Wakatte ita.

title.native: キスしたら壊れるのは分かっていた。
title.romaji: Kiss Shitara Kowareru no wa Wakatteita.

136024.description:
Ye-Sul Hong has a secret – when she kisses someone, she can see flashes of their future. It’s hard to believe she’s ever met the right guy when she can’t even see herself in their destiny. She doesn’t get much use out of her ability until one day, when she accidentally kisses her evil boss, Min-Hu Cha, who’s got a secret of his own. To her utter shock, she sees a vision of herself… in bed with him! As if that’s not confusing enough, she shows up to work the next day to find out that her first love has been hired to work in her department. Will she be able to survive working with the man she wished had been her destiny and the man she’s destined to be with?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

136025.description:
Some people thirst for power while others want nothing more than to live low. Ha-Min has always been resentful of the label that comes with being his father’s son—he didn’t ask to be born into a mob family! After much trial and error, Ha-Min finally breaks ties with his family and begins to live the life he's dreamed about. That is, until he gets kidnapped and finds himself under the protection of a certain Kwon Se-Hyeok. All Ha-Min wants is his "normal" life back, but Se-Hyeok is as far from normal as a person can get...

(Source: Lezhin US)

136026.description: Kotori-kun, who falls in love with his classmate Hiiragi-san at first sight, somehow wants to get close to her. Hiiragi-san is quite an earnest and lovely girl, but… She’s surprisingly a little careless—! This is about the charming school life of a careless girl and a pure boy who gets led on everyday by her — a romantic comedy that’s a wee bit H sometimes but warm and fluffy to death.

title.native: ちょっとだけ抜けちゃう柊さん

136029.description:
After giving up everything and going against his parents' wishes to pursue his dream of becoming a concert pianist, Lee Siyoon is met with a crippling end to his short-lived career when a car accident leaves his right hand immobile. Finding no reason left to live, he attempts to end his meaningless life. But, instead of meeting his maker, he awakens in the company of a large group of Russian servants. Thrown into this new life as Russian heiress, Tatiana Yuryevna Belchenova, there is one thing that's still familiar, the piano. Unable to give up his dream, Siyoon decides to embrace being Tatiana and attends the most prestigious classical music school in Russia. But, with Tatiana's body refusing to cooperate with Siyoon's mind, will he manage to make it to the top this time? To make matters worse, he's surrounded by some surprisingly tough competition and they're all still just teenagers! Confronted with Tatiana's dark secrets, family and classmates who despised the old Tatiana, and teenage boys who are overly interested in the new one, Siyoon has a long road ahead of him.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: タティアーナの夜明け

136030.description:
Ai no Utagoe wo Kikasete tells the story of the beautiful and mysterious Shion who transfers to Keibu High School where she quickly becomes popular due to her open-hearted personality and exceptional athletic talent...but she turns out to be an AI in the testing phase!

Shion's goal is to bring chronic loner Satomi "happiness." However, her strategy is something no human would expect: she serenades Satomi in the middle of the classroom. After finding out that Shion is an AI, Satomi and her childhood friend, engineering geek Touma, steadily warm up to the new student. Along with the popular and attractive Gocchan, the strong-willed Aya, and judo club member "Thunder," they become more and more moved by Shion's singing and earnestness even as her antics bewilder them. But what Shion does for Satomi's sake ends up involving them all in some serious pandemonium. Get ready for the heartwarming story of a not quite market-ready AI and her classmates!

title.native: アイの歌声を聴かせて

136031.description:
When Sa-Rang discovers a mysterious yellow umbrella left by her doorstep, she doesn't think much of it. But one rainy evening she opens her umbrella and is magically transported to Albia where she runs into two men, one of whom could potentially be her soulmate. Will Sa-Rang be able to find her true love in a foreign land on the other side of the globe?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

synonyms: The Psychology of Harem to Establish a Kingdom
Creating a Harem in Another World with Psychology

title.native: 心理学で異世界ハーレム建国記

136033.description:
A short after story to Meiya's route in Extra. Focuses on overburdened Takeru (and Tsukuyomi) trying to spend some time alone with Meiya.

Note: Originally published in Dengeki Muv-Luv, finished in the second issue.

title.native: MUV-LUV EXTRA 冥夜と！ちょこっとAfter
title.romaji: MUV-LUV EXTRA: Meiya to! Chokotto After

136034.description:
For some reason, only Kumakura-sun notices Hachiya-kun, an anonymous mob character who usually goes unnoticed in class! Conversely, Kumakura-san's true face is a secret that only Hachiya knows.

(Source: Monthly Action, translated)

136035.description: Professor Nishimura, an archaeologist investigating ancient ruins discovered in the Congo, sends his daughter Satsuki in Japan a mummy arm called "Jacob's Left Hand". What is the fate of Satsuki, the girl who has the power of God in her hands? The monster battle action with the special beast-machine powered Satsuki!

title.native: みんなに言えないことがある
title.romaji: Minna ni Ienai Koto ga Aru

136038.description:
After graduating from high school, Minori decides to attend art school against the protests of her mother. While throwing herself into her work, she happens to meet two fellow male students: Fujioka Takashi and Kagami Touma. Kagami uplifts people with his confidence and kindness; Fujioka's confidence inspires. Thanks to these two boys, Minori is able to overcome the struggles she's been facing her entire life. But what happens when one of them wants something more...?

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

136039.description:
A mysterious machine turned people into Dakgangjeong (Korean spicy chicken). It turns out that a great secret is hidden within the mysterious clues of the deaths and disappearances of those involved...

(Source: Naver, translated)

136040.description:
Like many before her, successful BL author Kwon Mina cut her teeth on fanfiction in her youth, writing sordid tales about her favorite stars in sensual scenarios with their bandmates. Now a professional novelist, Mina’s determined to write the best romance since the invention of paper and ink…and what better source of inspiration could there be than the one that started it all - her ultimate bias Kang Woobin! All is going well with her newest idol romance until - plot twist! - the very same idol-turned-editor himself is put in charge of her newest manuscript. Unsure if honesty or secrecy is the best way forward, Mina debates telling him about her past as his number one fan, but Woobin is no longer used to life as the main character and has made an effort to close the chapter on that part of his life. With Mina’s professional life hanging in the balance due to her provocative past, there is only one thing for certain: her former bias can’t find out!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: My Former Bias Can't Find Out

136041.description: A furoku by Megumi Mizusawa published with Ribon 1999-09.

136042.description:
In this light novel based on the Moriarty the Patriot series, William visits a department store in London to get a present for Louis and Albert when it is suddenly attacked by a mysterious armed group! Together with help from a mysterious girl, William tries to get control of the situation. Meanwhile, Sherlock becomes Gregson’s assistant as he investigates a locked-room mystery!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: Moriarty The Patriot: The Girl Who Sees the Rainbow

title.native: 憂国のモリアーティ 虹を視る少女
title.romaji: Yuukoku no Moriarty: Niji wo Miru Shoujo

136043.description:
William is intrigued when a man in a tavern sees through Moran's cheating and challenges him to a game of poker for a large sum of money. There's also an over-zealous Louis who names the tropical fish he's assigned to keep "William", Albert and Moran compete in a wine-drinking contest, and John becomes a detective instead of Sherlock, and shows off his famous (?) deductions. The daily research records that were not shown in the main story are released for the first time!!

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

title.native: 憂国のモリアーティ “緋色” の研究

136045.description:
Unrivaled in the parallel universe by using psychological knowledge! A story with a new standard of romance!

An unfortunate high school boy, Shinta Nanpa, loves girls but can't talk to them properly due to his female phobia. Shinta, who was sent to a parallel universe by chance, has to use the only weapon he has to start off, which is his psychological knowledge. His target is an elf, fairy, and a mermaid!? The story with a new standard of romance, starts here!!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)
synonyms: The Psychology of Harem to Establish a Kingdom
Creating a Harem in Another World with Psychology

title.native: 心理学で異世界ハーレム建国記

136046.description:
I, a great monster killer, was about to plunge my knife into a vampire’s heart to avenge my parents’ death… when I woke up in a princess’s body instead! All I want is to return to my world so I can complete my revenge. But here I am, stuck in the body of a princess who is considered bad luck by the entire kingdom. Well, at least there’s one other man who got tossed here from another world, too. Hopefully, we can find a way back, or else I might be killed!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I'm a Killer, But I Want to Live As a Princess

title.english: A Monster Hunter Becomes a Princess

136047.description:
On his first day of school, high school student Namito Kominato is seated behind a strange girl who is always soaking wet and wears a paper bag. He starts up a club called the "Conversation Club" with a group of somewhat unfortunate yet beautiful girls: shy and always embarrassed Kamiyama-san, caring but obsessed with her uniform committee chairperson Hinata Arai, and Harusame Amano, who talks to a panel of a magical girl... A slightly unfortunate coming-of-age love comedy begins!

(Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

title.native: 紙山さんの紙袋の中には
title.romaji: Kamiyama-san no Kamibukuro no Naka ni wa

synonyms: いつか大人になる日まで 橋本正枝

title.romaji: Itsuka Otona ni Naru Hi made

機械仕掛けのアイオライト

136052.description:
A single father raising twins wants nothing but the best for them, but he didn't expect that he'd need breast milk! A beautiful married woman offers to sell them, and things start to get real steamy...

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

136053.description:
As the one and only fire witch in 300 years, Liona spends her life isolated from the world... until she falls for Rakus, prince of the Kingdom of Carrell. But after he betrays and kills her, she opens her eyes as the newborn baby princess of the Hasys Empire! With her OP-level strength and royal dragon-blood lineage, she’s out for revenge against Rakus. To get there, she must first secretly harness her mana, find people she can trust, and defeat her 11 siblings to gain the power of the throne!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: องค์หญิงขาโหด

136054.description: Shizuka, a shy office lady, was invited by a colleague at the company to go to a mixer, but she felt suffocated by the glittering atmosphere around her. "I'm always dull and have an equally dull self who always wants to help people." She wanted to escape from such a reality, and on this day, she suddenly got inspired. "I want to change this time!" And so she decided to go to the cosmetics counter of the department store. There, she met Minato, a cosmetologist, and learned how to put on make up, but his eyes, smile, and supple and gentle hands kept her excited. When she asked him to "help her change" and met him again at a later date, he made a suggestion...
synonyms: Koi to Sex wa Touch up no Atode
Love And Sex Will Make Your Mind And Body Happy After Touch-up

title.native: 恋とセックスはタッチアップの後で 心も体も快くしてあげる
title.romaji: Koi to Sex wa Touch Up no Nochi de Kokoro mo Karada mo Kokoroyoku Shite Ageru

136055.description:
Germany, 18th century: A young man named Werther leaves his hometown and goes on a sentimental journey.
Based on the novel by Johann Wolfgang von Goethe, one of the most famous German authors, "Wakaki Werther no Nayami" paints a picture of love, youth and alienation.

(Source: East Press, translated)
synonyms: Las penas del joven Werther, el manga

title.native: 若きウェルテルの悩み

136056.description:
At a glance, high-schooler Moran Baek appears to be a beautiful girl who’s perfect in every way… or so it would seem. In reality, she is an exiled demon who has been trapped in a human body for over 5,000 years. When she learns that she is still unable to use her demonic powers despite finishing her exile, Moran despairs and struggles to find a way to become a demon again. One day, she accidentally discovers that doing a good deed restores her powers, and sets out to find a way to keep doing good deeds so she can return to her devilish ways.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra.
synonyms: Lord, Please Turn Me Back Into a Devil!
Lord, Let Me Be the Devil!

title.english: God, Please Make Me a Demon!

136057.description:
Izumo is a part-time high school social studies teacher, and he has feelings for Muroto - a popular, handsome physics teacher. As the graduation ceremony for seniors draws close, Muroto takes refuge from his enthusiastic female students in Izumo's classroom. To Izumo, he says, "Please be my girlfriend!!" Also, it seems that Tomogashima, a student who's close to Izumo, likes Muroto as well...

The love triangle that revolves around a lighthouse's legend begins during spring break...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

136058.description:
Kaoru Kuze, a school nurse, was forced to transfer to a countryside high school due to being relentlessly stalked by a co-worker. His first day starts out rough when he walks into his new office, only to be greeted by Motoaki Wakura, a tall, blonde guy who looks like he belongs in a gang...! Kaoru soon learns that this scary looking guy is in fact very caring and dependable. When Kaoru falls asleep in his office one day, he's shocked to find Motoaki beside him when he wakes up, with a flirtatious look on his face...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title.english: How To Remove A Lab Coat
title.native: 不器用な白衣の脱がし方

136059.description:
She can take 1000 men! Pussy is power!!

(Source: FAKKU)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2018-10
synonyms: Adventure of a Slut Around Thirty

136060.description: Note: This is debut work of mangaka that also won "Weekly Shonen Champion Rookie Manga Award," published in 1979

136061.description: Time-traveling lovers Katsumi and Sakura find themselves in the midst of Japan's medieval civil war between the Heike and Genji clans.

136062.description:
Around 1955, rental bookstores—which lent books for 10 yen a day—were on the verge of their heyday. At the time, there were four manga publishers in Osaka catering to these rental shops, and Hinomaru Bunko in Semba was a bustling hub where young, impoverished but dream-filled artists—including Takao Saito, Masaaki Satou, Yoshihiro Tatsumi, and Masahiko Matsumoto—gathered! This is the story of these artists, who would later popularize a style of manga known as “gekiga,” and the beginning of the history of gekiga itself!

(Source: Seirin Kogeisha, translated)

136063.description:
Yukio was destroyed in battle and Tetsuo survived in an escape pod. After eight years in cold sleep, the escape pod finally lands back on Earth. But when Tetsuo emerges he finds a world in ruins, entirely frozen beneath a blanket of ice and snow—snowball Earth! What happened to humanity, how did the planet freeze over, and will Tetsuo be able to keep his last promise to Yukio?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.native: 魔剣使いの元少年兵は、元敵幹部のお姉さんと一緒に生きたい
title.romaji: Maken Tsukai no Moto Shounenhei wa, Moto Tekikanbu no Onee-san to Issho ni Ikitai

title.native: 激動のまなぴす～生きたいように生きる女子道～
title.romaji: Gekidou no Manapisu: Ikitai You ni Ikuru Joshidou

136067.description:
In a war-torn feudal Japan filled with mechs and magic, the greatest ronin never known, Yasuke, struggles to maintain a peaceful existence after a past life of violence. But when a local village becomes the center of social upheaval between warring daimyo, Yasuke must take up his sword and transport a mysterious child who is the target of dark forces and bloodthirsty warlords.The story of Yasuke, the first African samurai who actually served the legendary Oda Nobunaga, will be released to the world.

(Source: Netflix)

136068.description: Menhera-chan is a satire manga series created by Ezaki Bisuko. Menhera-chan was originally vent art due to the stress Ezaki has gone through, and was considered a way of escapism to distract himself from the harsh reality of university exams. Originally created in 2014, the character and manga had become extremely popular over on Twitter. Menhera-chan is largely based on magical girls and mental health combined, which would be titled Yamikawaii (Sickly Cute).

136070.description: Narumu fell in love at first sight with a model kit of her favorite girl which got her hooked on the hobby. But the world of plastic models is deep. Narumu wants to make her ideal plastic model of a mecha girl, as she sinks deeper and deeper into the plastic model swamp…!

title.native: なるむちゃんは沼に落ちた

136072.description: Tenkou-kun is the coolest, handsome kid in the class, whom all the girls adore, and Yumemi has just discovered that she’s going to live with him and his parents while hers are overseas. But it turns out that Tenkou-kun isn’t the cool character he seems to be at school. In fact, he’s quite bizarre, just like his parents…

136075.description:
Using a cock mic for an obscene concert. ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2016-01

136076.description:
Kaoru accidentally swallows a ring that falls from the sky. A girl says, "Give back Cherry's ring!" but he can't. From then on Kaoru's life dramatically changes…

(Source: Beaglee)

136077.description:
On Chiiko's 11th birthday, her father gives her a special book. Inside the book is a trapped witch, Majokko Tickle. When Chiiko frees Tickle from the book, she uses her magic to pass off as Chiiko's twin sister.

(Source: Anime News Network)

136078.description:
To become the ultimate game character, you must meet three conditions: gain access to the game's "Lord System" control panel, take over the body of a noble family's illegitimate son, and make sure nobody else knows they're in a game. Well, Richard Orlando fulfills them all! Now he must build an army and fight through goblins, gnolls, trolls, and more to discover new lands, all while keeping the Lord System a secret. But with that trump card on his side, it'll only be a matter of time before he conquers all and becomes the ultimate Lord of the new realm!

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: I am the Strongest Lord in another world

title.romaji: Wo Shi Yishijie Zui Qiang Lingzhu

136079.description:
The forbidden relationship between teacher and student in a thrilling age-gap yuri story!
Yukiko-sensei in her white coat is cornered against the wall by her student Kozue and kissed passionately.
You'll fall in love with Kozue's bold and naughty teasing. Please enjoy the secret yuri relationship filled with the best things about bold younger girls.

(Source: Melon Books, translated)

136081.description:
Cho Sun-won finds his life boring and tedious. Sex is the only thing he isn’t sick of, but it’s getting a little too easy to talk any guy into bed. He wants a new life, a new world, and a new challenge…and he totally gets all of those when he’s summoned into another world as the so-called god of Abroria! Awesome, right? Except, nobody seems to fall for his bedroom talk, and there’s a sexy king hell-bent on exposing Sun-won as a fraud. Seducing the gorgeous men around him without blowing his cover is going to be quite the divine challenge. Can Cho Sun-won actually become the Chosen One?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: How to Be the Chosen One

136083.description:
Maji, through many experiences, becomes a yakuza who makes a name for himself throughout the country. Meet again his straightforward feelings and chivalrous spirit, his thrilling battles, and his beautiful, fragile love for Kumiko in the final arc of Maji!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)
synonyms: 本気（マジ）！ 終章 火薬

title.native: 本気! 終章 火薬

136084.description:
The traditional fairy tale we all know is actually a crime drama about the shapeshifters who fled from the sky!

This story is about a fox sent down from the sky and Joseon’s greatest gisaeng swindler, Cho-Ran. Many skillful storytellers turn the gears of fairy tales around to talk about the evil gods and goblins who torment humankind, but let us now start a true story of love that will make even the sky tear.

(Source: Naver)

136086.description:
The day I accidentally met you, my story began to change.

(Source: Kakao Webtoons)

Note: chapter count includes a 5-chapter side story

136087.description:
When Na-Gyunn’s twin brother, Na-Jin, is murdered before his very eyes, he vows to avenge his brother’s death by assuming Na-Jin’s identity. But although the two may look alike, when it comes to fighting, Na-Gyunn lacks the talent and skill his brother possessed. In order to successfully execute his plot for revenge, Na-Gyunn resolves to train himself to become the prodigious knight-in-training his brother once was. Will Na-Gyunn be able to keep his identity a secret before others begin to catch on to his act?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Last Knight From The Fire

136088.description:
Hosu is an average, carefree high school student who isn’t particularly special in any kind of way. Danwoo is the attractive, untouchable top student of the class. There shouldn’t really be any reason for them to interact at all. But one day, Danwoo announces that he wants Hosu to sit next to him in class. In fact, he wants to be within her presence as much as possible, and he’s willing to do whatever it takes to stay by her side. Not too close, but not too far. Just two steps away is enough. However, will they be able to maintain that distance? Come take a closer look, from just a couple steps away…

(Source: Lezhin US)

136089.description:
#Cover illustration: Kasukabe Akira
#Illustration: Ranma Nekokichi
#Illustration: RT.
1. Yukueshirezu no Pleiad (行方知れずのプレアード) [Hoshiai Hiro]
2. Wo Atsurae (おあつらえ) [Utsunomiya Ranjirou]
3. White Drop (white drop) [Mikami Hokuto]
4. Waitress Complex (ウェイトレスコンプレックス) [Kagechin]
5. Ma Immoral ☆ Oni Taiji (真インモラル☆鬼退治) [Kirigakure Takaya]
6. Still Echo Chapter 2 (スティル・エコー 第2話) [Uchoten]
7. All God's Chillun got Rhythm (ALL GOD'S CHILLUN GOT RHYTHM) [Aoi Takayuki]
8. Eiyuu Houkei Hawkeye Jewel Hitokawamesoo! Kimi Koso ga Uchuu ichi no Houkeida (英雄包茎ホーケージュエル一皮目そう！君こそが宇宙一の包茎だ) [Sakamoto Hayato]
9. Context or Context (CONTEXT or CONTEXT) [Macop.]

136090.description:
Ra-Ri’s entire world falls apart when her boyfriend dies. Overwhelmed with the pain of losing the love of her life, she decides to go through the bucket list they made together before joining him in death. Things take an unexpected turn when fate links her to Han-Sol, her neighbor who has a painful story of his own. The two embark on a journey to heal their wounds and learn there is more to life than trauma and heartbreak.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

136091.description:
Life has been anything but easy for Ju-In On. She is unlucky in love, finances, and career. So when she finds out that her current company has been bought out, she just takes it as another tough break. However, the company that bought out her previous one doesn’t want to fire her… they want to hire her! Ju-In On believes her luck has finally turned until she meets the CEO of the company, Jae-Heon Do. He’s handsome, smart, charming... and the one person she hoped to never see again.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes a seven extra chapters.
synonyms: ความสัมพันธ์ที่เคยจบลง

136092.description:
Ahn Geum-hoo needs a butcher to provide fresh animal blood for his sickly brother’s medicine. While most of the butchers seem reluctant to provide him with what he needs, Nobody is willing to do Geum-hoo’s bidding. With striking features and a strong build, Nobody has quite a reputation amongst the village folk. Yet, Geum-hoo finds a way to tame this wild tiger. First, he gives him a name—Beom. Then, he invites him to a world that this nobody’s never experienced...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: A Tiger Frost on the Snow

136093.description:
With the soul across the Millennium, she has become the daughter of the down-and-out film emperor? All right, let those who addict to me thrive! Look at how I, together with my father and brothers, change my fate and become a lucky little one loved by all the group! But…being spoiled, I found that the expression of eyes of one of my brothers on me has changed …

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: The Boss Is Three and a Half Years Old
Three and A Half Year Old Boss

title.english: Our Pampered Sister's Secretly a Big Boss
title.romaji: Tuan Chong Da Lao San Suì Ban

136094.description: This is a gag manga that uses the height and size of the main character, Dekka-kun, as a joke. Dekkaa-kun's behavior surprises the people around him and makes them laugh.

136095.description:
Laughter, excitement...
Everything is "big"!
It's too big!

This is the biggest manga in the history of Japanese manga.
Maybe even the biggest..
Protagonist to ever appear in the manga world!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.romaji: Waka to Hanaya to Hanataba to

136098.description: Note: Winner of the 2020 Torch Manga Taisho Grand Prize.

136099.description:
A high school student, Im Da-Joon is used to being bullied at school. Right before he was about to end his own life, he saw the interview of a friend killer on TV by chance. He got impressed by the interview and decided to seek revenge. His revenge was successful, but his life went in the wrong direction… Im Da-Joon quit school and joined the group of teenagers who ran away from their homes. Da-Joon is now free from school bullies, but now he has to survive against the street gangs who are much tougher than school bullies.

(Source: YLAB)

Notes:
- Includes four extra chapters.
- Belongs to Blue String universe.
synonyms: เหยื่ออย่างผมต้องรอด

136101.description:
The writer and the animation director of Evangelion and Revolutionary Girl Utena team up for a new visual story. About a boy who gets caught up in the mysterious events at a boarding school.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

136102.description:
Prim and proper Ayano is head over heels for Hasegawa-sensei, her Japanese teacher. But when her (undeniably hot) English teacher catches on to their affair, he threatens to spill more tea than the Boston Tea Party unless she wholly submits to his every whim...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Chapters count includes chapter Extra1.5, Soushuuhen 1 kaki oroshi, Extra 2, Extra 4, 4.5, M Extra, 5 Extra, 6 Extra, 8 Extra, 9 Extra, 10 Extra.

136103.description:
Alisa, a university student studying oceanography, is rescued from a village where she is lost during a research trip and meets Gideon, a prominent figure in the village. But the village and its people have secrets of their own.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.romaji: Umi no Kenzoku to Itsuwari no Hana

136104.description:
Xiao Ling is a young girl who travels with an old doctor, searching for ores and medicinal herbs. She meets a beautiful man who turns into a tiger.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

136106.description:
Melilot is the second princess of the Wind City. She is ordered by her father, King Roland, to travel to the Valley of the Golden Green with the white wizard Robin.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 妖精国の騎士Ballad ～金緑の谷に眠る竜～
title.romaji: Alfheim no Kishi Ballad: Kinryoku no Tani ni Nemuru Ryuu

title.native: ハイパーダッシュ!四駆郎

136108.description:
After the incident in Harrisburg, Altodias seemed to have regained its peace. However, the beasts have mutated and are causing damage to the people. Robin, who has been treating the beasts in the old castle of Altodias, takes a certain beastmaster's child as his apprentice.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 妖精国の騎士 Ballad ～継ぐ視の守護者～
title.romaji: Alfheim no Kishi Ballad: Tsugumi no Mori

136109.description:
One day, while rushing to a piano lesson, a girl named Saki collides with someone on the street. As Saki collects herself, the stranger picks up the sheet music Saki dropped, hands it to Saki together with a band-aid, and continues on her way—all without saying a word. Saki is left wondering about the identity of the tall, lovely stranger, only to discover the next day that she is one of her classmates at her new high school. The girl’s name is Kanon, and though she is hearing impaired, she refuses any kind of support or “special treatment” from her teachers or classmates. Over the course of the year, Saki slowly grows closer to Kanon and begins to chip away at her cold exterior.

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: La luna en una noche de lluvia

title.english: The Moon on a Rainy Night

136111.description:
During the school entrance ceremony, student body president Kazu is reunited with Hideki, a younger guy he used to hang out with when they were little kids. The formerly eccentric Hideki's grown into a fine young man, but now he's acting cold towards Kazu. That's because long ago, when Kazu saw Hideki's dad having sex with another man, he hurt Hideki by saying, "That's disgusting......" At the time, Kazu hadn't known that Hideki was trying to tell Kazu he loved him and had taken Kazu's remark as a rejection! Now that Hideki's cleared up the misunderstanding, he's become an uncontrollable puppy-dog that keeps following Kazu around......!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: I Wish You'd Stayed a Kid.
title.native: こどものままでよかったのに。
title.romaji: Kodomo no Mama de Yokatta no ni.

136112.description:
A girl with a pair of bony braids has been labeled as evil since birth. One day, she is accidentally struck by a dragon egg, and a cute yet fierce baby dragon hatches from it. Together, they embark on a journey to find their respective homes. Along the way, what obstacles will they encounter?

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: Sunny With a Chance of Dragons!

136113.description:
Hernan's and Roselia's lifes are threatened, and another assassin sneaks into the country...!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 二人きりの兄弟 新ローゼリア王国物語
title.romaji: Futari kiri no Kyoudai: Shin Roselia Oukoku Monogatari

136114.description:
Just after the Second World War, London is still in the early stages of reconstruction.
Flora works in a classical nurse's uniform, and Lewis is a doctor who wears a coat covered in leaves. What will happen to their love when they meet, guided by the fortune telling of the Duke of Greenwich, who is also known as the Duke of Horoscope?

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 十二夜の魔法使い～星占い公爵と恋人達～
title.romaji: Juuniya no Mahoutsukai: Hoshi Uranai Koushaku to Koibito-tachi

136115.description:
In northern Italy in the 16th century, Elena, a brilliant young woman, is summoned by Maria, the wife of Giovanni. She asks her to work for Davide, a mercenary who has been chosen by the lord of a certain town.

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

136116.description:
After zombie vaccine is developed, cured people are suffering from the memory when they were a zombie. Story between Zombie and human, after an ending credit

(Source: Naver)

136117.description: Bundled alongside, the 10 pages oneshot features Iwamoto Yoshihiro's take on the original Megaman X5 ending, using the version of the characters first featured in his adapations of Megaman X1 trough X4.

136120.description:
This thirst cannot be quenched! ❤

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2021-07

136123.description: Japan has become a desert nine years after a global disaster. A young man meets a young girl driving a mechanical animal, pursued by an organization. Their epic journey begins!

title.native: グレイト トレイラーズ

136125.description: A series of 4-koma focused on the world of Puyo Puyo, specifically the fourth instalment Puyo Puyo~n.
synonyms: ぷよぷよ4コマ ぷよよん

136126.description: Legends speak of a great constellation of stars, only visible to those who possess true strength. Having lost his ability to see those stars, Akira walks the earth in search of answers. His quest pits him against powerful fighters like the Koenkan and the mysterious Kage Maru, and lands him in the center of an international conspiracy. For the first time on DVD, come the adventures of Akira, Jacky, Sara and Pai. Facing off with the greatest martial artists from all over the world, all the top characters from the best-selling video game are ready for action!
synonyms: バーチャファイター―TVアニメ原作

title.native: 炎の八極拳 バーチャファイター

136127.description:
Deep sea dark fantasy.
The bottom of the deep, deep sea, water pressure, darkness, low water temperature ... This is an unexplored, desperate place.

A combination of Libitina, a woman in a jet-black suit packed with lost technology, and Jack, a shallow-sea people, seeks ancient human relics and conquers the dangerous abyss of weak meat and strong food.

By evading the threat of humanoid monsters "ghosts" roaming the seabed and giant deep-sea creatures, they can escape from the "worst world" and be exposed to the warm "sunlight." Or ... !!

136129.description:
Since ancient times whoever inherits the divine power would inherit the world. But who would have thought that one day the Divinity Clan would be wiped out and the divine powers passed on to a girl? Thus, a female emperor ascended the throne to rule and protect the world. Surrounded by people who always spoke flattering words, yet harbored ill intent, and constantly faced with the skepticism the people who were supposed to be close to her - how can a woman stand such hardship? How will this female Emperor deal with this unjust and patriarchal society?

(Source: KuaiKan Manhua)
synonyms: Ni Yu: God is a Girl

136130.description:
Where is my happiness?

The story of a 30-year-old with growing questions.

(Source: Naver, translated)

136131.description:
Mana is a manga artist who has been married to her husband, Etsuro, for three years. Even though she knows Etsuro hates it, she finds herself drawn to cigarettes and alcohol. One day, Mara finds out that she is pregnant and begins to cut down on her drinking and smoking, but she is worried about the changes in her life. At week eight of her pregnancy, she suddenly can’t stop bleeding. As she is rushed to the hospital, she wonders what will happen to her child.

Tenshi no Watsuka is a collection of stories, all connected by themes of family and love.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

136132.description:
Jeong Sun-I, 22, returns to Chunjang High School.
An 8th-grader is showing interest in Sun-I, who is calm and quiet.
Will Sun-I be able to finish her high school safely?

(Source: Naver, translated)

136133.description:
After her mother passed away, Eun-Su moves to Miseon Villa 201 in Seokchon, which her mother was the owner of. A healing journey of forgiveness and growth.

(Source: Naver, translated)

136134.description:
One winter day, Turner, a shoemaker in modern-day England, comes across Benny, a seemingly homeless young man barefoot and shivering on a park bench. Concerned about this stranger who claims to be a former angel, Turner decides to invite him into his home to avoid the bitter English winter. As the two get closer, Turner decides that he wants to make shoes for Benny, who's putting his all into learning about the human realm. Benny ends up living with Turner during the months-long shoemaking process, but will their arrangement come to an end when the shoes are complete?

(Source: Animate International)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

136136.description: Chihiro Ayase and Sota Fujisawa are lovers. They like each other, kiss each other, and touch each other often. When they decide they want to experience something better, they find that the reality is that sex isn’t as easy as it seems. Chihiro and Sota are scared to go further, and they’ve even been interrupted during their attempts! But even though some obstacles stand in the way of their goal, they still share the same love.
synonyms: ลงเอยด้วยรัก

136147.description:
"I want to make you all mine."

Yui is hired to work at a Law Firm owned by the Jin family. Two handsome Jin brothers, Yushiro and Soichi are Yui's childhood-friends, but Soichi is her first love. Yui's first day at the office is the first day meeting with Soichi after 18 years. Soichi has changed drastically and almost seems like a different person...?! This romance is pure and thick like honey.

(Source: MangaPlaza)
synonyms: Blind Passion of the Attorney in Black

title.english: Blind Love of a Dark Lawyer: The Most Obsessed and Pure Love Story in the World
title.native: 黒弁護士の痴情 世界でいちばん重い純愛
title.romaji: Kuro Bengoshi no Chijou Sekai de Ichiban Omoi Junai

136148.description:
Part 2 of the Kamui Gaiden saga serialized in Big Comics. In Part 2, the theme of "Gaiden" is not to focus on the battles between ninjas and their special moves, but rather to focus on the grander theme, which is about the thoughts and hopes of those who are hunted and who question the status quo.

(Source: Wikipedia Japan, translated)

Note: "Kamui Gaiden Part 2" is a continuation of the previous series. In the Japanese edition, the first three volumes recollected the stories from the first part while the ones from Part 2 where included from volume 4 onwards.

title.native: カムイ外伝 第二部

136152.description:
In January 1942, Todo, who has an amazing memory, is assigned to the heavy artillery regiment at the fort in Tsushima. What did he experience during his three months of training there? Finally, a masterpiece of Japanese literature that was said to be absolutely impossible to make into a manga!

Winner of the 2007 Tezuka Osamu Creative Award

136154.description:
A collection of one shots:
1. Oku-san nante mou Takusan (おくさんなんてもうたくさん)
2. Uta no Tsubasa (歌の翼)
3. Francesca no Shiroi Niwa (フランチェスカの白い庭)
4. Iin desu! Doctor (いいんです！ドクター)

title.native: フランチェスカの白い庭

136155.description:
The excellent game player is a part-time model in real life?! The senior he respects most is his hard-core fan?! His double identity is going to be exposed... What should he do? Admit it or guard the secret with his life?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.native: 脱オタしてはみたものの
title.romaji: Datsuota Shite wa Mita Mono no

136158.description:
In modern-day Japan, Yadoya Kenta is the typical overworked employee of a black company. It’s to no surprise when he dies from overwork one day, but when he wakes up, he finds himself as the Hero o-... Wait, that’s not it. Uh… he finds himself reincarnated as Tory, the son of two innkeepers in the fantasy town of Rubella! This time, Tory will make sure that he lives a leisurely life where he only works in moderation! Surrounded by a kind family and lively customers, he aims to enjoy a relaxed, slow-paced lifestyle as the son of innkeepers! This is a fantasy of a relaxed work life!

(Source: MANGA UP!)
synonyms: Tensei Shitara Yadoya no Musuko deshita: Inakagai de Nonbiri Slow Life wo Okurou
After Reincarnating, I Became the Son of Inkeepers

title.english: I Got Reincarnated as a Son of Innkeepers!
title.native: 転生したら宿屋の息子でした 田舎街でのんびりスローライフをおくろう
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Yadoya no Musuko deshita: Inaka Machi de Nonbiri Slow Life wo Okurou

136159.description: Feng Qi, a young UFC fighter who fell from the top, he returns to China to live an ordinary life, but he discovered that high school life is even more exciting than the UFC. Although Feng Qi doesn’t want to fight for his reputation, he can only defend himself and become strong in order to protect all his loved ones. Although his left arm is badly injured and has only his right hand, Feng Qi will not run away from a fight. “I, Feng Qi, doesn’t violate the law, won’t do illegal activities, not bully the weak.”

136160.description:
On my 25th birthday, I made one wish: for a man to sweep me off my feet. But then I woke up in another world as a human princess promised to a vampire duke! Now I'm surrounded by bloodthirsty men who want to marry me—and, really, who am I to refuse them? Especially when my life depends on it!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Duke of Cold Blood's Plan of Attack

136161.description: A princess loses her kingdom and is cursed with a magic spell that gives her one of those famous womb tattoos that makes her constantly horny. While journeying with her childhood friend to bring back their kingdom, she has various, well, slutty adventures behind his back.
synonyms: Bitchful Adventure of Magical Princess Makina
The Slutty Adventures of Magical Princess Makina

title.native: 淫紋魔法姫マキナのビッチな冒険
title.romaji: In Man Mahou Hime Makina no Bitch na Bouken

136162.description:
Akira Ryuuzaki is a maniacal yakuza that everyone fears! However, something strange happens, causing the inside of his mind to leak out to the people around him… but his mind is actually filled with tremendous kindness!? A heart-warming yakuza comedy where he makes everyone happy without his knowledge!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

title.native: 最凶ヤクザの心の中は意外とやさしい
title.romaji: Saikyou Yakuza no Kokoro no Naka wa Igai to Yasashii

136167.description:
Early Meiji era: as civilization develops at a dizzying pace, Suzu arrives becomes a silk mill leader and meets a beautiful Frenchman named Jules. He came to Japan as a hired foreigner, not being able to speak the language, he felt so lonely he retreated into his shell. In order to bring him back to work, Suzu puts on a dress and spends the night with him. He is a gentleman, but the president orders Suzu to support him as Jules' "Western mistress". As she works hand in hand with him to overcome difficulties, the two of them somehow become strongly attracted to each other...

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)
synonyms: シルク・ロマンス～異国の青年と紡ぐ恋の糸～
Silk Romance: Ikoku no Seinen to Tsumugu Koi no Ito

136170.description: A collection of short stories by various mangaka.

title.native: 聖女の魔力は万能です 公式アンソロジーコミック ～聖女の書～
title.romaji: Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu: Koushiki Anthology Comic - Seijo no Sho

136171.description:
I learned that whenever I'm with you, every ordinary day turns into a treasure.

1. Motto Anata wo Suki ni naru Ichinichi (もっとあなたを好きになる一日): A boy who hates his voice and a girl who is troubled by her temperamental personality meet online and become a couple after revealing their complexes to each other, but what happens on their first date?
2. Banken-kun to Birthday (番犬くんとバースデー): A delinquent childhood friend who disappeared three years ago returns as a police officer on his 20th birthday...
3. Tenshi-kun no Sasayaki (天使くんの囁き): A friend's brother, who was cute as a girl, suddenly comes to visit her on a night when she wants to run away...
4. Gou-shiki no Omajinai (業式のおまじない): A high school couple on the verge of adulthood meet at the school early in the morning on graduation day, but...?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: もっとあなたを好きになる一日
title.romaji: Motto Anata wo Suki ni naru Ichinichi.

136172.description:
Adam is a high school boy who has been separated from his childhood crush Beau since he was 9

One day, a handsome model transferred into his class, and the person turns out to be Beau!

Since Beau is so different now, Adam is unsure of how their love will play out

(Source: INKR Comics)

title.english: I Give Up On My First Love As of Today!

136173.description:
I’ve transmigrated into the world of the BL webtoon "In The House of Dolls, There’s Another Doll Living There" where I left my one and only spiteful comment. On top of that, I become the adopted younger sister of my favorite character: the obsessive male lead who is later regretful for his actions but still dies along with the duke in the end.

So, I was determined. Since I have transmigrated into this world, I can’t stand by and watch my favorite character die. Additionally, I also don’t want to die. That’s why, author, I'll need to change the tags and the ending of this webtoon slightly! From "Obsessive Male lead" to "Considerate Male Lead". From "Sad Ending" to "Happy Ending".

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: This is a promotional manhwa for the web novel of the same name.
synonyms: I Became the Younger Sister of a Regretful Obsessive Male Lead
If You Want to Touch Me, Come Here Anytime.

title.native: ふれたくなったら、かえっておいで

136175.description:
A manga adaptation of the classics Taketori Monogatari (The Tale of the Bamboo-Cutter) and Uji Shuui Monogatari (The Tale of Uji), a collection of stories from the Kamakura period. With the manga that helps you understand the flow of the stories and the notes that supplement the manga, you can enjoy learning about the contents and the historical background. This is a great introduction to the classics and can be read easily even by first-time readers.

(Source: Gakken, translated)

title.native: まんがで読む 竹取物語・宇治拾遺物語
title.romaji: Manga de Yomu: Taketori Monogatari, Uji Shuui Monogatari

136176.description: A manga adaptation of Shakespeare's classic play "Romeo and Juliet".
synonyms: マンガジュニア名作シリーズ

title.native: ロミオとジュリエット

136177.description:
While other students were preparing to take their CSAT exams, Lee Yu-Han was swept up in an exhilarating lifestyle of crime and debauchery. While working for a loan shark, karma catches up to him when a family member dies from an act of revenge against him. After years of repenting for his sins and trying to turn over a new leaf, he meets a man in the entertainment industry who gives him the opportunity to get his revenge…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

136178.description:
A sad tragedy befalls a mother and daughter living in the mountains. This story is based on folk song Akita Nagamochiuta.

Note: This is debut work of mangaka, which was published in the April issue of Garo in 1969.

136179.description:
Zhan Zhixia and Qin Chuan were deeply in love with each other, but due to differences, they broke up. Three years later, they still think about each other even when they claim they've moved on. But with one simple chat message, they didn't expect that fate would lead them to one another.

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: A Thousand Miles Across the River: Qin Chuan and Zhixia

title.romaji: Ge He Qian Li, Qin Chuan Zhi Xia

136180.description:
While haunting her usual subway car one day, lonely ghost Park Ja-Eon receives a chance from a deity to redo one year of her life and earn a spot in eternal paradise. With the aid of a grumpy divine guardian and a newfound ability to see ghosts, Ja-Eon restarts her senior year of high school. As the unlikely duo ends up helping spirits and humans alike, they begin to reflect on their own relationships and regrets. But with the clock ticking on Ja-Eon’s second shot, is there time to set it right?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Winner of the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Grand Prize at the 2019 Korea Contents Award. This work was first serialized on Dillyhub in 2018. Munhakdongne has been publishing it since 2020.

136181.description:
The high school girl Sena met a young man with a mysterious charm on a school trip. As she stared at him, he suddenly kissed her! He's Yugetsu, a cursed raven tengu! He told Sena that he had to marry a human in order to lift the curse, and declared, "You're my wife from now, Sena!"

(Source: Pixiv Comic, translated)

title.native: いしゅ婚！～天狗のかりそめ花嫁～
title.romaji: Ishiyu Kon!: Tengu no Kari Some Hanayome

136182.description:
Rokka...
Are you strong enough?
Overcoming the grief of losing Chika, Rikka's new challenge begins.
Yamagishi Ryouko's long-awaited second part of her full-length ballet manga finally begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 舞姫 テレプシコーラ 第2部
矢口高雄名作シリーズ

136185.description:
"Please," his classmate begs as she raises his hand to cup her soft, yielding breast, while his hot member probes at her moist entrance. Make me a hot mess…

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 21 episodes and 7 chapters respectively.

title.native: 初体験は教室で。～1年H組セックス公開授業中～
title.romaji: Shotaiken wa Kyoushitsu de.: 1-nen H-gumi Sex Koukai Jugyou-chuu

136186.description:
In their early twenties, Mikami Toshiya and Hiraoka Keiji were mountain climbing partners. Over the next few years, though, Mikami chose having a family and stable career over his passion for mountain climbing. Now he has a wife and son, and he has turned his back on the mountains entirely. In his dreams, he is doing all sorts of things with a girl in his class, Nemuri Yume, including cosplay, mixed bathing, and suddenly moving to a love hotel! As a seasoned adventurer, he has achieved a decent level of status and wealth, but with no prospects for marriage. So he continues to work diligently, without knowing what the next day would bring. With the wealth he saved up, he decides to buy a slave. And then, his days begin to change little by little...? A slightly unusual love story of a middle-aged adventurer begins!

She got mad and attacked him with her wooden sword, but he fended her off and defeated her easily. Afterwards, Chiyoka's parents tried to set her up with Yoshizo, a naval officer who turned out to be the man who beat her in that sword fight. The two were married without any affection for each other, purely a marriage of convenience. But on their wedding night, Yoshizo pushed Chiyoka into bed and said, "This is what should be done between husband and wife."

The aliens are prohibited from stopping at ports other than Dejima, but various crimes began to occur frequently on Dejima, where different civilizations and values were mixed.
In order to protect the security of the area, the Dejima Police of the Earth Alliance, the Federation Police of the Space Alliance, and a mixed force of aliens and earthlings were established. This was the "Gundragon".
Gundragon's investigator, Sigma, stopped a runaway truck carrying smugglers. On the back of the truck, a Mumerian from a water planet, who commits suicide to protect its secret. Sigma sneaks into a tavern in search of his friends, where he finds a Mumerian and a small black hole, which is forbidden by the United Space Federation...

But powerful countries target the small frontier kingdom and infiltrate it with assassins who want to kill the queen!

136506.description:
In search of her dreams, Lin Chu-sheng quits university, leaves home and starts working for a funeral director. Her first job: a decomposing corpse. And before the shock of seeing her first dead body has passed, she is set to work, cleaning floors and washing bodies. It might sound like simple work, but she has plenty to learn…

And while she may work with the dead, most of her time is spent dealing with the emotions of those still living: a father unable to accept his son’s suicide; a bigamist’s families meeting only after his death; a mother unwilling to let a child go; and parents unsure if their son’s body will ever be found. Lin witnesses the full range of human experience and reflects on her own family and life.

(Source: Books From Taiwan)

136510.description:
On Namito Kominato’s first day of high school, he fantasizes about making friends and walking home with a girl. Luckily, he’s seated behind a gorgeous girl in class! She’s tall, strong...constantly dripping with sweat...and...she wears a paper bag over her head?! Meet Samidare Kamiyama, a kind but shy student with severe social anxiety. Though Kamiyama couldn’t talk her way out of a wet paper bag (literally—it’s hard to breathe under there), Namito gets her to open up. The pair become fast friends, and soon enough, the outgoing, uniform-obsessed class representative is joining in. Together, they decide to found the “Conversation Club” to help Kamiyama participate in high school life. The club needs four members to become official, and there just so happens to be the perfect addition: a student who can only talk to a cardboard cutout of a magical girl! When given a welcoming space to be themselves, even social outcasts can flourish. Let the first meeting of the Conversation Club commence!

Mayuri has an unusual reaction to the mantra that resonates in the statue of the Peacock Myou, the guardian deity of Myouji Temple...

136527.description:
Even as a working adult, Sarasa Ichinokura suffers from an unshakable fatigue that’s plagued her since childhood. She goes to bed one night, exhausted from her office job, and encounters a goddess(?) who informs her that her perpetual lack of energy is actually due to a deficit of “mana.” Then, without any further explanation or time to process what’s happening to her, Sarasa is thrust into a fantasy world! She awakens in the body of a ten-year-old girl in a strange land filled with flying beasts and oversized wolves. She accordingly prepares for the worst, but a monster hunter named Nelly takes her in. The hitch is...now that Sarasa finally has the energy to do everything she wants to, being cooped up in a cabin is just no fun! She seeks to stand on her own in this scary new world—and that’s going to mean learning magic. It may be slow going, but Sarasa knows what to do—the best way to take her reincarnation is one step at a time!

Even in his dreams, Li Tianming can’t stop himself from laughing! Why? Because his family pets are all the Primordial Chaos Beasts of myth!
That teeny weeny little chick over there is actually the eternal Infernal Phoenix that eats suns! His black cat is the Genesis Chaos Thunderfiend that refines worlds with its lightning.
The cockroach, well, it’s the Myriad Worlds Deathless Beast that possesses trillions of undying clones…
Followed by his menagerie of pets, Li Tianming begins his ascension to become the number one beastmaster of the ages. He journeys across the many worlds, only one thing remaining constant. No one is ever ready for the likes of his pets! After all, who's ever prepared to fight a chicken and its fellows.

136828.description:
Mikado – gay, once a famous playboy and womanizer – lost his former brilliance and splendor, having a marriage of convenience. However, Mikado, who has cooled to carnal pleasures, meets a new employee – Serizawa, with whom he slowly falls in love. This guy, obsessed with sports and cleanliness, awakens our protagonist’s wild fantasies and reignites his long-forgotten desire. The mysterious Serizawa, together with Mikado, who is obsessed with him, they go on a business trip and stay for the night at an onsen, where Mikado discovers an unexpected secret about Serizawa …

(Source: Frontier Works, translated)
synonyms: Do you have any problem with me?

136830.description:
Saguru Sakio is a detective who uses his ability to see into the future to solve cases. But his power cause him to see a future where his stepsister Marie fucks him silly!

(Souce: Fakku!)
synonyms: Future Detective: The House Confinement Incident

136832.description:
Midou, a young 32-year-old general manager of a major company, and Katsuya Saeki, who was recruited by him and became his subordinate. The two have been in a secret relationship since they met through work.

"You just have to think about me." At home, Katsuya is loved enough by the sadistic Midou, but at work, his co-workers envy him, and he wavers in his desire to be a suitable "lover" for Midou, who is 7 years older than him...!?

(Source: Libre Publishing, translated)

136833.description:
Monica Everett, the Silent Witch, is the world’s only practitioner of Voiceless Magic, a veritable heroine who single-handedly fended off the Black Dragon of legend. However, the young prodigy is actually…super-duper shy! Yup, turns out she only learned Voiceless Magic to avoid speaking in public. Ignorant of this, the Seven Sages have placed her on a top-secret mission to guard the Second Prince. Can Monica keep it together as she contends with both social interaction and the evils targeting the young royal?

(Source: Yen Press, edited)

136836.description:
An unpopular woman in her thirties, our protagonist’s only pleasure in life is reading all the web novels she can get her hands on while soaking in the bath. Tragically, she carelessly fell asleep in the bath and drowned, and before she had opened her eyes, she entered a fantasy novel world with a fictional Otome game theme. What’s more is that she transmigrated as the villainess Leysritt!

All I wanted was to be able to enjoy my second life quietly! But because I saved the prince’s life after he was run over by a carriage, the prince’s younger brother took interest in me, and now I’ve become his fiance?! With my knowledge from being a nurse in my past life, I want to be of help in this world. If I want to avoid a future of ruin… I must aim to be like Nightingale.
synonyms: Villain Lady Wishes To Be Like Nightingale

title.native: 悪役令嬢は夜告鳥をめざす
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou wa Nightingale wo Mezasu

136837.description:
After an unfortunate accident, a lonely woman in her thirties finds herself reincarnated as Leysritt Von Lotus, a beautiful, young noble lady. Instead of worrying about boring things like meetings, her biggest problems now include which snacks she wants served with her tea. But something feels off... This world looks an awful lot like the ones in the stories she liked to read in her past life! What if she's not the protagonist, but actually the villainess?! Watch as Leysritt navigates her brand new life, using her education as a nurse to overcome challenges and capture the hearts of those around her!

(Source: Comikey)
synonyms: Villain Lady Wishes To Be Like Nightingale
คุณหนูตัวร้ายขอกลับใจเป็นไนติงเกล

136839.description:
Iki's high standards and idealism made her an unpopular figure at work. Until Narita, a newcomer rumored to be a former recluse, suddenly confessed his feelings for her...!?

(Source: Petit Comics, translated)

title.native: 潜入妻サトミ 洗脳凌辱の記録
title.romaji: Sennyu Tsuma Satomi Sennou Ryoujoku no Kiroku

136841.description:
"The Association of Fakes" - Those that do not fit the category of normal living things are called "fakes", and this is where they gather. A buff and muscular cactus, a pebble that wants to be a bird, a pair of earphones that hates human ears and finally, there's the "fake" human.

18 year-old Tsutsumi Watako has just entered university and there's actually a secret about her body. And that is that her body will sometimes turn into a blanket! While she was feeling troubled by her secret, the president of "The Association of Fakes" appeared before her...

"You're a very precious fake "human". Welcome to the Association of Fakes!"

The "president" seems to be a man who's crazy about anything fake and Watako soon started working for him. Soon enough, our "fake" female university student, Watako's world continues to expand as her gentle, mysterious yet flustering days begins!

A comedic fairytale-like story about fakes that is overflowing with tenderness. This is dedicated to all the living fellow fakes who cannot become the real thing!

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

136842.description:
A spin-off manga of Tom and Jerry, where Tom works at a Café with seven rainbow-coloured Jerries.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

人妻恋花火 ～初めての不倫が3Pに至るまで～

136844.description:
"It takes more to satisfy me."

Dayoung has the looks, the talent, and the wealth to back everything up, but she desires only one thing - having her friend Jae-seung watch her as she embarks on her risque digressions. Whether it's in the library, on the school grounds, or at home, Dayoung calls Jae-seung whenever the mood strikes her. But how does Jae-seung feel about all this? Behind the thrill and the facade are the haunting traces of his past, ever so lasting as a burn.

(Source: Lezhin US)

136845.description:
"I'm home, Master. We can finally get married...?"
On her sixteenth birthday, Minamo suddenly meet her childhood friend, Yui, whom she had been separated from for a long time. He used to always hide behind Minamo's back, but after 10 years, he has transformed into a handsome man and has become extremely forceful...?
This is a crazy and sexy love story with a pet that won't listen to you!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

136846.description:
A new couple moved in upstairs and the noise they make is unbearable! Time to get revenge on them. But wait, are these guys really a couple? And how can such a cute girl exist? A funny, cute story for the ages!

(Source: DAYcomics)

136847.description:
Ichibana, who is avoided by boys because she seems flamboyant and playful, is actually extremely shy and has no experience in love. Her friends are worried about her, so they call in a rental butler...!
She has to train with the butler, to get used to boys, but this butler is actually a little bit mean...?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.romaji: Iwafuru Shitsuji no Nasu ga Mama

136848.description:
Yeo-ho is a k-pop idol who’s struggling to financially support his younger siblings and keep his comatose mother alive. Desperate to make it big, he tries to make connections with the right people—but it all goes wrong when he finds himself on the brink of getting dragged into a drug scandal. The only person who can save him is the powerful representative of a conglomerate, Hyung-joo. To save his career, Yeo-ho must make Hyung-joo an offer that’ll change both of their lives…

(Source: Lezhin)

136849.description:
Ban Su-Ho, a guard who died after failing to protect the Princess from the assassins! Back in time two years through an unknown force! “This time, I must…” Determined to protect the Princess he sets out in search of the sealed power to become stronger. Will he be able to protect the Princess?

(Source: Kakao, translated)

136851.description:
Mai wants to make a boyfriend at the summer festival... but she gets the lowest grade on the test!
In order to get a passing score on her catch-up test and go to the summer festival, she decides to ask Yono-kun, a genius, to teach her how to study. She first thought Yono-kun was scary, but he's really hardworking and kind... and he promises to take her on a date to the summer festival if she gets a passing grade...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Suki na Hito to Hanabi o Miru Houhou

136852.description:
In a different world, the royal family is in decline and turmoil continues.
In a cold village, an infant named Ars has a memory of his previous life where he was passionate about "city-building" games, and starts building houses with his own magic to get out of poverty!
He hatches a rare servant beast, cultivate the land, clear it, build Roman-style roads and castles...
The heroic tale of a boy who will later be called the "living god" begins!

(Source: Trista, adapted and translated)
synonyms: I Was Reincarnated As A Poor Farmer In A Different World, So I Decided To Make Bricks To Build A Castle
Reincarnated as a Poor Farmer: Building a Castle Brick by Brick
Reincarnated as a Poor Farmer in Another World: I'll Use My Modern Knowledge to Build My Own Kingdom

136853.description:
Liam Hamilton is not who you think. On the surface Liam is the son of a failing noble family, but on the inside...he's actually a lowly peasant?! One night he's a miserable middle-aged commoner chugging cold beers at the local tavern and the next day he suddenly wakes up as the youngest son of a noble count?! Make it make sense! Liam Hamilton has no idea how he ended up this way, but he does know one thing for certain: as a noble he can finally try learning magic like he's always dreamed of!

Too bad the noble house he's been reborn into is on the verge of collapse–that is–unless they prove themselves worthy of high society. When Liam discovers he has a natural affinity for magic, can he save his doomed house or will he go back to being just another lowly commoner?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

136856.description:
32 years old, single, temporary worker. Sumika Yamada is lost in her marriage and her life.
She is captivated by the taste of the food she tastes in the café space of the antique store "Oriori-do" and by the manliness of the chef, Jin Tachibana.When she learns that Jin is looking for an assistant, she decides to help out at his "Shucchou Ryoutei" restaurant, where he serves food to people he visits.
How will the tripod of a woman who is not good at love and a handsome chef who is too hard-headed turn out?

(Source: Trista, translated)

136857.description:
The Gilbert family is said to have play a decisive role in the battle against the evil sorcerers during the Great Fire of the past. Ewald respected his uncle, who had become the general of the Holy Knights in this battle and had received a treasure from the royal family.
Ewald thought that the treasure, which was carefully kept in the treasure room of Gilbert's family, might be the "One and Only Grimoire" that trapped the evil power of the sorcerer. But then he learns that a book similar to this grimoire is being sold on the back market...?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

136858.description:
The moment omega, Wan Xing Shu transferred into the class, he became the target of the cunning Alpha, Chu He Zhou. After a series of services from the Alpha, who managed to flirt the omega to the point that his heart beats fast, his weak legs shaking and he wishes to be pushed down by the Alpha. Until a second year Alpha bully called Wan Xing Shu “Brother”, Chu He Zhou was confused. What is his soft and cute omega hiding?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Originally published under the same title as the web novel, Xueba Jintian Liao Dao Xiao Nai Bao Le Ma (学霸今天撩到小奶包了吗).

136859.description:
Twelve years after someone close to him is ripped away, Lille Ou has become Dr. Ivan, a man with a flourishing medical career who has seemingly put his tragic past to rest. But the stability of his world is challenged when a gunslinging pretty boy barges into his home demanding first aid and a place to lie low. Despite the danger of it all, Dr. Ivan finds himself drawn to this ruthless fugitive with superhuman strength who miraculously transcends his one weakness: physical touch. As Dr. Ivan sets out to learn more about his mysterious intruder, he's dragged into a futuristic underworld of criminals, gangs, and AI technology. And little does he know that it just might help him uncover the truth about himself and the person he never stopped searching for.

(Source: Tappytoon)

A collection of selected chapters from Kanako Inuki's other works:

6. Warau Mon ni wa Tomo Kitaru (笑う門には友きたる) from Fushigi no Tatari-chan

title.english: Be Very Afraid of Kanako Inuki!

136864.description:
Meet Chise, a young girl who is reborn in a new world with her old memories lost. A goddess grants her the gift of 'Creation Magic' under one condition - that she enjoys her new life! Together with Teto, a golem she creates, Chise embarks on an enchanting journey across the world.

(Source: MangaUP!)
synonyms: Living it up in Another World as a Witch of Creation!

title.english: Making Magic: The Sweet Life of a Witch Who Knows an Infinite MP Loophole

136865.description:
Looks like I’ve been reincarnated into a gamelike world filled with monsters and dungeons. But don’t worry—it’s nothing I can’t handle. I chose Creation Magic for my unique skill, you see, and it lets me make whatever item I want...so long as I’ve got enough mana. Ah, there’s always a catch, isn’t there? But where there’s a rule, there’s a loophole—and this little witch knows just the trick to expand her mana pool a bit more each day.As for what I’ll be up to in the meantime, first I’ll make a friend. (Literally. Golems are a thing in this world.) Next, I’ll make some tracks. (And the sooner, the better. The goddess dropped me off in the middle of the wastelands). Then finally, one day, I’ll make myself a place where I can truly belong. (That’s the plan, at least.) Time to make some magic!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

136867.description: Includes the one shots Lunn wa Kaze no Naka (るんは風の中) and Barbara (ばるぼら).

136868.description:
Alice, a girl who was reading the complete works of Osamu Tezuka in the forest, chases a rabbit that suddenly appears and falls down a hole - but it is a terribly deep hole, and she cannot easily reach the bottom. Before long, Alice was starting to fall asleep, when the Firebird comes to her and gives her a quest, to "find a way to return home from the land of Osamu." What will be Alice's final fate?

A new representative work by Kentaro Ueno, which is packed with material drawn from Osamu Tezuka's huge collection of works, with an original and emotional ending. This is an ambitious work that boldly tackles Tezuka's 700 titles!

(Source: Tezucomi, translated)

136869.description:
Choi Sun-Woo and Ahn Hae-Jin couldn’t have come from more different backgrounds. With a renowned linguistics professor for a father and an extremely successful author for a mother, Sun-Woo was perfectly set up for a successful career in writing. Ahn Hae-Jin however, had been left to take care of himself ever since he was in high school, working part time jobs just to survive. The two become unexpected friends as the sole members of the creative writing club, but after a dramatic falling out, Sun-Woo and Hae-Jin lose touch for years until unexpectedly meeting again working for the same publishing company. Sun-Woo and Hae-Jin try to keep things professional, but their sudden reunion dredges up painful memories from the past along with feelings they had both struggled to suppress…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

136870.description:
After the war, the humans who struggled to survive on the devastated planet suddenly gained two powers. People used these powers to regain their strength, but they knew very little about its origin. 12 years later, Noah, received his first mission to find the truth about these powers. During his journey, he was accidentally caught in the attack of the messenger "Black Thunder", what will await him?

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

136871.description:
Stories about cravings and lust taking over rationality. "Love Me Love XXX": Maeda returns to his hometown for a reunion party with his high school club alumni. What kind of memories will fill his mind, and what new memories will he make? The bespectacled, seemingly pure and innocent Maeda may not be the full picture. (Warning: child molestation) "Casual Encounter": Natsuo has always had a connection to snow. So, when he fell in love at first sight riding the train on the year's first snow day, it must have been fate. But... why does this Yuki person seem so familiar...? "Give Me More Love": The only interaction that Matsuda, an Honor Student, and Takagi, a student punished for having too many tardies, is at the library after school, sitting opposite each other. That wasn't enough for Matsuda, though, making the Honor Student do something, well, not so honorable.

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: 大好きだから絶対◯◯したい

136874.description:
A young woman sick with an incurable illness closes her eyes for the last time, only to wake up as Ariel Winston, an antagonist of the novel she had loved reading before her death. Knowing that death lies before her if she continues down the path the real Ariel has been going towards, she quickly breaks up with Duke Cedric Evans, who is not only the protagonist of the novel, but a man who is cursed with a condition which causes him to become bloodthirsty when he does not smell a specific scent constantly. However, Cedric, who had been forced to date Ariel due to her status as his personal perfumer, suddenly seems reluctant to distance himself from her. Just what is wrong with this man, and how will this change the events of the novel? Will Ariel be able to live the life she wants?

(Source: Copin Comics)
